text: Corn plots (Pre and Post sides) - Weed counts and collection from 8 randomly paced 10' row lengths from inside 6 rows
Soybean plots - (RR and conv. sides): Weed counts and collection from 8 randomly paced 10' row lengths from inside 6 rows
Seed O3 oats: 72 lb/a IN09201 oat + 12 lb/a 'Duration' red clover, and O4 oats: 72 lb/a IN09201 oat + 15 lb/a 'FSG 400LH' alf. with 6.5' Tye drill in 8" rows
Apply liquid UAN fertilizer to C2 plots with 60' wide JD self-propelled sprayer: 100 lb. N/acre rate
Level all corn plots with field cultivator
Plant Agrigold 6395 conventional or Agrigold 6395BtRW (no RR gene) corn on designated east or west half (107-day mat.) 32,200 sds/acre in 30" rows
Apply preemergence herbicide to 'Pre' side of each corn plot - Zidua 3.5 oz/ac + Balance Pro 2.0 oz./a, 20.7 gpa carrier volume: REI = 12 hr
Level all soybean plots with field cultivator
Plant soybeans Kruger K-287RR or K-2918/SCN on designated 'pre' or 'post' half - 9.3 sds/ft, (162,000 sds/a) 30" rows.
1st cutting alfalfa: mowed A4 plots with 7' wide disc mower
Rake, bale & weigh A4 hay.

On designated 'Post' half of each corn plot: 15" band spray @ 2.45 mph (24 gpa carrier volume):
3.0 oz/ac oz Laudis - corn V4 stage, corn 7-10" tall : Laudis REI = 12 hr
Cutivate corn on 'Post' half with 6-row cultivator, JD 2955 tractor, 3-4 mph with shields up

On 'post' half of each SB plot:- 16" band applied over row: 12 oz/a SelectMax + 8 oz/a Phoenix + 4 oz/a Resource, 25 gpa in band: REI = 24 hr
Also add 0.2% v/v Nonionic surfactant + 2 lb/a AMS + 0.2% antifoam agent
Soybeans ~ V4, 4 to 5" tall. Velvetleaf 3-5 leaf stage (2-4" tall). Foxtail 2 to 7" tall. Waterhemp 2-4" tall, LQ 2-12" tall
Broadcast 25 oz./acre Roundup PowerMax (49% glyphosate) + 0.75% v/v Formula One to 'RR' side of each soybean plot: REI = 4 hr
Cultivate 'post' half of each soybean plot with 6-row cultivator, shields down
Second cutivatation on 'post' half of each corn plot: with 6-row cultivator
Second cutivatation on 'post' half of each soybean plot: with 6-row cultivator, Case-IH 5250 tractor, 4 mph with shields up
Apply 30 oz/acre 41% glyphosate to 'RR' side of each soybean plot - Cornerstone Plus + 0.75% v/v Formula One; 18 gpa carrier volume: REI = 4 hr
2nd cutting alfalfa: mowed A4 plots with 9' wide disc mower.
Rake, bale & weigh A4 hay
Harvest O3 and O4 oat with JD 9550 combine, 25-ft head , weigh entire plot into weigh wagon
Bale oat straw. 1.5 large square bales per plot.
Clip O3 red clover & O4 alfalfa to 6-7" ht with 15' wide 'bat-wing' rotary mower to suppress weeds
3rd cutting alfalfa: mow A4 plots with 9' wide disc mower
Rake, bale & weigh A4 hay, one large square bale per plot. Avg. hay yield was 1.0 ton fresh wt./acre and 29% moisture
Corn plots (Pre and conv sides) - Weed counts and collection from 8 randomly paced 10' row lengths from inside 6 rows
Direct cut and weigh both A4 (4th cut) and O4 (1st cut) with JD 5830 self-propelled chopper, 12.5' wide head
Haul 3 grain truck loads (45 tons compost) from ISU compost facility
Harvest corn with JD 9550 6-row combine, weigh center 6 rows of each subplot
Shred corn stalks on all corn plots with 15' batwing rotary mower
Soybean plots - (RR and conv. sides): Weed counts and collection from 8 randomly paced 10' row lengths from inside 6 rows
Harvest soybeans with JD 9410 6-row soybean combine, weigh inside 6 rows, S2 = 52 bu/a, S3 = 58 bu/a, S4 = 61 bu/a
Chiesel plow ends of all plots except O4 for tillage buffer
Lightly disk S3 and S4 with 15' wide disk to level ridges created by summer cultivation and combine wheel tracks
Collect 4 x 0.25 m2 = 1.0 m2 total legume tops from east half of plots A4 and O3 for biomass and dug 12-15 plts/plot for root to shoot ratio determ.
Chisel plowed all corn plots with 12' wide JD chisel plow pulled by CASE-IH Maxim 150 HP tractor with front assist

Apply 7 ton/acre fresh weight composted beef manure to all plots of O3 and A4
JD 6400 tractor, gear C1 - 1500 rpm ~3.5 mph pulling Mark Hanna's large New Idea spreader (apron/chain setting 2/6), 4 - 15' passes per plot
Moldboard plow A4 and O3 plots with JD 2955 tractor pulling International model 720 4' - 16" plow, 8" deep
Apply 380 lb/acre granular postash (KCl) = 228 lb/a K2O to all plots with spinner pull-type spreader (50' wide spread width), one pass per plot
